verdict.rationale: Postman's Fabric Gateway lets teams register and expose MCP servers to their org (postman-docs-7), showing some MCP traffic management capability, but there is no evidence of LLM-specific governance features like token limits, prompt guards, or provider routing. Missing for 10: token/rate limiting controls, prompt injection/guardrail features, multi-provider LLM routing, and any documentation tying Fabric Gateway to LLM traffic governance specifically.
